recent_en: Recent announcements mainly involve changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including open market acquisitions and dealings during the closed period. The latest quarter ended 30 June 2026 saw revenue and net profit grow both quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year.
notable_en: Directors Oh Yen San, Ng Thean Gin and Lee Lai Chan acquired shares in the open market between 10 and 14 September 2026.
Independent non-executive director Khoo Lay Tatt disposed of 200,000 shares during the closed period on 27 October 2026.
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 20 November 2026.
risks_en: Independent non-executive director Khoo Lay Tatt disposed of 200,000 shares during the closed period.
Several directors indicated intention to deal in shares ahead of the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR24,547,000 and net profit was MYR4,155,000, with a net margin of 16.9%; revenue grew 37.7% QoQ and net profit 27.7% QoQ, while revenue rose 43.7% YoY and net profit 162.5% YoY.
